title: ID0388323-DC/Si-D/AT- [rx9MJg] Outlet 1 OoO , LEM error
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Charger has blocked Outlet1 because of a LEM error. We have tried some steps  to fix the error but it seems that the meter has lost the connection completely and needs to be replaced.
Root cause:
Solution:
Issue found in the power connections to the LEM due to false contact.  issue resolved by RC.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:  No
Warranty Status: Active

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0388323-DC/Si-D/AT- [rx9MJg] Outlet 1 OoO , LEM error CRM:00796000949
additional_info.body:
I have one good news and two bad news regarding the malfunction.
The good news first, the station is working again. :)
The bad news no. 1: The fault was caused by two 24V supply terminals of the meter not being tightened. (Photo attached)
Even if only one wire is visible in the photo, both screw terminals were not tightened.
This explains why the charger ran for a week without any problems and then went into fault mode the day before yesterday. Loose contact.
I had the seal with me through my ERK course, someone else would not be able to reseal it.
Bad no. 2: As you can see in the other photos, both plug retainers are broken. These need to be replaced as soon as possible. On the right crack, you can see inside the charger.
It appears that water has already come through the cracks and is dripping onto the meter covers. The charger was fitted a week ago.
I will open a separate ticket for the plug retainer so that this can be closed.
Also attached is my work order.
LG
Daniel

Charger SW Version
: v4.0.11+retopics
Reason for Handover (ES/NOC
):please close the ticket. issue solved
